body: RELAY ISSUE #1 IS OPEN ON THIS REPO and proposes this project's own intake lane: https://github.com/BIWizzard/meeting-ingest/issues/1. Filed 2026-07-31 from the iq-context session under the new cross-project relay convention (Relays sections of ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and ~/.codex/AGENTS.md), owner-directed. The ask, in priority order: a triage step in this project's session workflow that polls `gh issue list --label relay` (the load-bearing half — a lane nobody polls is a check that never runs), then the relay label (already created), a .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/relay.md copied from BIWizzard/iq-context commit cf60578, and a docs line naming the lane. One design question reserved for this project's context: whether the template distinguishes bugs against a shipped receipt from requests against the source repo, given the receipt-managed release flow. First intended use once the lane exists: the catalog-as-native-tooling relay drafted in iq-context on 2026-07-30 refiles as the first content issue, retiring the last hand-carried draft. This capture is the same-machine courtesy notification; the issue is the record; the poll the issue proposes is what makes future relays discoverable without a capture like this one.
